lawsuits.allegation_summary: Filed by ACLU-WV, the Haslam Law Firm, and Glazer, Saad, Anderson immediately after Huntington City Council approved a $2.1 million Flock Safety ALPR contract in a contentious 6-4 vote; alleges the city failed to follow required procedures in awarding the contract, including improper authorization for a private company to use public property for the cameras.
lawsuits.status_detail: Lawsuit filed July 14, 2026, same day as the council vote; ACLU-WV legal director indicated additional legal claims could follow beyond the procedural challenge.
